verdict.rationale: Digits documents its own API versioning scheme: route-based, with the version number as a URL path prefix, and the /v1/ OAuth endpoints are consistent with that. The pack never shows the deprecation side of the story, so only half of it is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset timelines, migration guidance), changelog or version-lifecycle documentation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The Digits Connect API uses route-based versioning with the version number as a URL path prefix.
